body.label: Rolling agreement with auto-labels over the last 20 checked minutes. Not a benchmark — the observed values come from the same detector counts the forecasts are made from. Benchmark figures are in Results.
body.limits: Not accuracy: both sides come from one detector's counts, not human-verified traffic. These are the live persistence and ridge forecasts, not MFSTNet; this camera and these minutes only; no forecast drives a signal (P97a).

body.note: what the edge last reported about itself: its source and its lane map. Times on this page are when the server received each message, not when the footage was recorded
observed: the mean number of vehicles in each lane's counting region per bucket, as counted at the edge; a measurement, not a forecast. A bucket with no samples is a gap, never zero
